tasks.subject: [agent-teams-seat-asides] [Admission] Classify verified seat replies and unsolicited targets
tasks.description: Add narrow seat port and chat-seat-target helper. Preserve agent-id DM and ordinary sendable predicate/origin list. Explicit seat-chat target resolves live authoritative room/member/registered agent and captures roomId,authorId,joinedAt,targetSessionId; reject self/canonical self. Explicit replyTo must be FROM same seat TO caller including verified aliases; forged identity NOT_ALLOWED with no unsolicited fallback. Without explicit reply use newest valid unanswered else unsolicited. Revalidate pinned scope every launch and after relevant await; cross-room/leave-rejoin/replacement fails, same-room native rekey okay. Seat chat_stop remains denied. No bridge switch or schedule/beat-origin change. Require original session ledger binding identity so leave/rejoin at identical fake joinedAt refuses; authoritative retirement chains preserve same-room canonical rekey. Persist immutable seat_session_id separately from receipt destination. Reuse existing ordinary origin eligibility plus room; permit relay-binding/null only with current server-owned exact bridge/ledger tuple, captured and revalidated through placement/native rekeys. All known unattended/external-event origins remain closed despite hybrid ledger rows. Real metadata/adopter tests preserve legacy and Direct-room compatibility; no guessed facts or new schema. Active answers require message/start and working/delivered/steered. Atomically reserve one pending receipt per ask; authentic stale/reserved ids become unsolicited, forged ids refuse. Bridged seats accept answers only, including inactive bridge policy and a bridge attached while waiting; the active bridge tuple grants legacy-origin reach only for genuine answers.

tasks.subject: [agent-teams-seat-asides] [Inbox] Implement bounded queue and truthful receipt settlement
tasks.description: Create RoomSeatMessages collaborator with FIFO pending queues keyed by pinned seat scope, one active batch; named defaults25 pending/seat,1000 global including active accounting,1h wait deadline and existing30s release recheck conventions. Overflow refuses UNAVAILABLE without dropping old rows. Take longest FIFO prefix whose final fenced/defused/metadata/separators length<=5*CHAT_MESSAGE_MAX; single source message must fit or reject before acceptance. Budget.remaining zero early refuses reasonbudget without row/trace; askAside reserves once per accepted runner attempt after placement/current-target/disposal/known-pause guards; known pre-run refusals consume zero, later runtime/protected-dispatch refusal may consume the attempt. No refund or deeper launch hook. Changed budget settles failed. Return queued promptly; working only on claim, truthful delivered/failed terminals. Stop/restart expire rows honestly and clear timers. Any steer/interrupt request downgrades to queue with note; never call plain dispatch,steerInto,interruptTurn or queue-head controls for seat targets. Each inbox owns an independently scheduled earliest-pending-deadline timer so queued rows expire even while an active aside remains unresolved; cancel it on stop/final cleanup. Only never-launched rows expire; active status remains truthful. Terminal updates use compare-and-set so restart/stop wins over late completion. Mark the linked active ask replied only with a winning delivered receipt CAS in one transaction; failures/recovery and thrown ask updates cannot fake an answer. Preserve original ask-sender activity across native aliases. Pre-run refusals release with a non-receipt outcome, not quiet completion.
tasks.activeForm: Implement bounded queue and truthful receipt settlement
